messages:
erin: Quick sync - BlueNova wants a streamlined signing flow: MSA signed by exec, orderform signed by finance team (they asked for delegated signer on the finance side). They also pushed a DPA redline asking for customer-managed KMS for hosted tenancy. attaching redlines: https://drive.internal/bluenova/redlines.pdf

alex (customer): correct. Our security team prefers control of keys for the POC environment, but we can accept a commercial carve-out if you offer an on-prem or dedicated option. prefer AdobeSign or DocuSign - need PO# on all invoices.

vikram (legal): We can't promise customer-managed KMS on our hosted multitenant product. Offer path: (a) Dedicated deployment + KMS integration under separate SOW, or (b) contractual audit windows and encryption-in-transit only for hosted. I'll prepare redline language: remove absolute KMS warranty and add migration/ops SOW option.

lia (procurement): BlueNova asked for Net30. Also need invoice remittance email and a PO number field on the orderform. Are we okay with Net30 for POC customers?

mira (finance): Net30 ok for enterprise POC if credit approved. we'll require invoices@bluenova-payables.com as billing contact and PO# on every invoice. I'll send our invoice instructions template.

tom (sales-ops): For e-sign routing, we can create an envelope with role-based delegation for the finance signer. Suggested workflow: parallel signing for orderform addendum and sequential for MSA then orderform if exec prefers. sample payload: ```{
  "envelope": {
    "routing": "sequential",
    "documents": ["MSA.pdf","OrderForm.pdf"],
    "signers": [
      {"role":"MSA Exec","email":"ceo@bluenova.com","order":1},
      {"role":"Finance (delegate allowed)","email":"finance@bluenova.com","order":2,"delegate_allowed":true}
    ]
  }
}```

erin: @vikram can you post the proposed MSA/DPA patch into the shared drive and call out the KMS fallback text? i'll update the orderform to add PO# and billing contact fields. @tom will prep the signing envelope and set delegation flag for finance.

vikram (legal): Uploaded draft: https://drive.internal/bluenova/msadpa_patch_v1.docx. Key edit for DPA: replace specific customer-key requirement with "Customer may opt for Dedicated or On-Prem deployment subject to execution of a separate SOW providing for KMS integration and related controls." added subprocessors list and 30-day audit window.

contracts-bot: Document uploaded by vikram (legal): msadpa_patch_v1.docx (sha256: def456...)

lia (procurement): Confirmed Net30 accepted. billing contact: invoices@bluenova-payables.com. adding PO field to orderform template.

tom (sales-ops): Envelope configured. Draft preview: https://esign.preview/7890. I enabled role delegation for finance signer and set reminder cadence to 2 days.

erin: Pricing ask from BlueNova: 10% POC discount on committed usage. we usually avoid permanent discounts for POCs. propose a one-time POC credit or time-limited promo. @mira thoughts?

mira (finance): Recommend one-time credit applied to first invoice after POC (capped at $5k). i'll insert standard POC credit clause: "Customer will receive a one-time credit up to $5,000 applied to the first invoice following mutually-accepted POC completion."

alex (customer): one-time credit and Net30 sound good. priority is to get MSA + orderform signed this week.

vikram (legal): Final redline posted. Note: MSA signature block needs printed name and title for exec. Also added clause that delegated finance signer must attest authority on behalf of counterparty.

erin: sending envelope now. @alex please sign when you get the link. I'll attach signed docs to CRM and open billing ticket.

alex (customer): signed both docs via delegated finance signer and exec signed MSA. got copies. thanks.

erin: awesome, closing this thread. action items: store msadpa_patch_v1.docx in legal folder, update CRM with signed artifacts, and finance to issue PO and first invoice with the credit applied. :white_check_mark:
